rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for an ordinary evening meal.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 maan5 faan6

rows.note: Use this for an optional light meal eaten late at night, especially before bed.

example.english: I want a little supper before bed.
example.traditional: 我瞓覺前想食少少宵夜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan3 gaau3 cin4 soeng2 sik6 siu2 siu2 siu1 je6

rows.note: Use this only for the specific fish-and-chips meal, not for an ordinary evening or late-night meal.

example.english: We went to the chip shop for fish and chips for supper.
example.traditional: 我哋去魚蛋舖食炸魚薯條做晚餐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jyu4 daan2 pou3 sik6 zaa3 jyu4 syu4 tiu4 zou6 maan5 caan1
